title_zh: 库克现身广州，探班 iPhone 18 Pro 咏春短片拍摄现场
content_zh:
10 月 10 日，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆·库克（Tim Cook）再次来到中国，并将此行首站选在广州，探班使用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列拍摄的咏春主题短片。

拍摄由青年导演古天鸡与咏春拳传承人戴子龙参与，在岭南风格的园林实景中，通过手机影像呈现中国传统武术。

探班期间，库克现场观看了咏春拳演示，并与主创团队交流移动影像拍摄及专业工作流程。据介绍，拍摄团队利用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的摄像头系统，在低光环境下记录快速变化的咏春招式。此外，古天鸡团队还向库克展示了一份使用 iPad Pro 搭配 Apple Pencil Pro 绘制的「武功秘籍」，以数字绘画的形式呈现咏春拳法。

库克随后在社交平台表示：「很高兴再次来到中国！在广州第一次透过 iPhone 18 Pro 镜头感受咏春的魅力，真是一次难忘的体验。」

值得一提的是，这是库克今年 9 月卸任苹果 CEO、转任董事会执行主席后首次到访中国。苹果现任 CEO 为约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）。
title_en: Tim Cook Visits Guangzhou to Preview Wing Chun Short Film Shot on iPhone 18 Pro
content_en:
Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook arrived in Guangzhou on October 10 for his first visit to China since stepping down as CEO last month. As the initial stop on his trip, Cook visited the set of a Wing Chun-themed short film shot entirely on the iPhone 18 Pro series.

Directed by young filmmaker Gu Tianji alongside Wing Chun practitioner Dai Zilong, the project showcases traditional Chinese martial arts within classic Lingnan gardens. During his visit, Cook observed a live Wing Chun demonstration and discussed mobile cinematography workflows with the crew. The production team demonstrated how the iPhone 18 Pro camera system effectively captures high-speed martial arts moves in low-light conditions, while also presenting a digital "martial arts manual" illustrated on an iPad Pro with Apple Pencil Pro.

Following the visit, Cook shared his enthusiasm on social media, calling it an unforgettable experience to witness the charm of Wing Chun through the lens of the iPhone 18 Pro. This marks Cook's first trip to China since John Ternus assumed the role of Apple CEO in September.

title_zh: 曝苹果 iPhone Duo 加单 30%，Pro 系列总订单量不变
content_zh:
据证券时报报道，苹果对今年秋季新款手机的订单作出结构性调整：iPhone Duo 加单 30%，调整后的总量仍未超过 1000 万台。

与此同时，iPhone 18 Pro 订单减少 10% 至 15%，iPhone 18 Pro Max 订单增加 10% 至 15%，Pro 系列总订单量保持不变。报道援引苹果供应链人士称，订单结构正向价值更高的产品倾斜，预计有利于相关供应链公司的业绩。
title_en: Apple Adjusts Fall Production: Boosts iPhone Duo Orders While Rebalancing Pro Lineup
content_en:
Apple has made strategic structural adjustments to its autumn smartphone production orders, according to a report from *Securities Times*. Orders for the new iPhone Duo have been increased by 30%, though the revised total volume remains under 10 million units.

Meanwhile, overall production volume for the flagship Pro series remains unchanged, but order distribution has shifted. Orders for the standard iPhone 18 Pro were reduced by 10% to 15%, while orders for the higher-end iPhone 18 Pro Max saw a matching increase of 10% to 15%.

Supply chain sources noted that Apple is leaning toward higher-value products, a move expected to boost financial performance for key manufacturing partners.

title_zh: 苹果第二期中国清洁能源基金扩容至 2.12 亿美元
content_zh:
10 月 10 日，苹果宣布第二期中国清洁能源基金的承诺投资总额增至 2.12 亿美元，约合 14 亿元人民币。新能源科技、鹏鼎控股与达尔科技等供应商加入出资，基金已完成初步投资，支持广西 260 兆瓦、山东 50 兆瓦两处风电项目，均已开工建设。

苹果同时公布，其在中国超过 95% 的直接生产制造现已采用可再生能源，目标是到 2030 年底在全球供应链全面使用可再生能源。由施罗德资本管理的第二期基金，计划每年为中国电网新增 110 万兆瓦时的风能和太阳能发电能力。

在工业供热减排方面，苹果正与山东创新精密推进铝材熔炼电气化，将已完成示范运行的电感应炉技术用于 MacBook Air 规模化生产。苹果还将向中国绿色碳汇基金会和北京自然之友公益基金会提供新资助，分别支持森林与城市碳汇试点、社区应对气候变化方案。
title_en: Apple Expands China Clean Energy Fund to $212M to Accelerate Green Supply Chain Efforts
content_en:
Apple announced on October 10 that its second China Clean Energy Fund has expanded its total investment commitment to $212 million (approximately RMB 1.4 billion). Major suppliers, including ATL, ZD Tech, and Diodes Incorporated, have joined as investors. The fund has already deployed capital into its initial projects, breaking ground on a 260 MW wind farm in Guangxi and a 50 MW wind farm in Shandong.

Managed by Schroders Capital, the second phase of the fund aims to add 1.1 million megawatt-hours of wind and solar capacity to China's power grid annually. Apple revealed that more than 95% of its direct manufacturing operations in China are now powered by renewable energy, supporting its broader goal of achieving 100% renewable energy across its global supply chain by 2030.

Beyond power generation, Apple is targeting industrial heat emissions by collaborating with Shandong Innovation Precision on electric induction furnace technology for aluminum smelting, which will be integrated into large-scale MacBook Air production. The tech giant is also extending new grants to local environmental non-profits, including the China Green Carbon Foundation and Friends of Nature, to support carbon sink pilots and community climate resilience projects.

title_zh: 四部门拟禁全隐藏式车门把手，要求车企如实宣传使用边界
content_zh:
10 月 10 日，工业和信息化部等四部门发布汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理通知征求意见稿，拟禁止配备全隐藏式门把手，并要求车企真实、客观开展营销宣传，如实说明创新设计的使用边界、限制条件和测试验证情况。

征求意见稿针对跟风推出新产品、测试验证不充分等问题提出要求：涉及安全的应急操纵件应保留实体操纵件和醒目标识；门把手须具备机械冗余设计和手部操作空间，并验证极端环境及紧急情况下的可操作性。行车时不可使用「零重力」座椅、旋转座椅或座椅放倒成床等功能。

按拟议安排，2027 年 1 月 1 日起，涉及创新设计的新申报产品需补充技术参数并完成相应测试；已取得公告的产品应在 2027 年 7 月 1 日前补报参数及验证材料。环境适应性验证周期不少于 1 年，可靠性验证试验不低于 3 万公里。

宣传方面，车企不得作虚假、夸大或引人误解的宣传，不得使用违反道路交通法规的场景展示产品功能，也不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全驾驶责任。上述要求目前处于公开征求意见阶段。
title_en: China Proposes Ban on Fully Hidden Car Door Handles and Stricter Auto Marketing Rules
content_en:
China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, alongside three other regulatory bodies, has released draft regulations aimed at tightening safety standards for innovative automotive designs and marketing practices. Under the proposed rules, fully hidden door handles will be banned, and automakers must retain physical emergency controls with clear, visible labeling.

The draft mandates that door handles feature mechanical redundancy and adequate physical space for manual operation, with verified reliability under extreme weather and emergency conditions. Additionally, features such as "zero-gravity" seats, swivel seats, and fully reclined bed seats will be strictly prohibited while vehicles are in motion. Automakers are also required to ensure truthful marketing that explicitly discloses functional limits and avoids depicting illegal driving scenarios.

If finalized, the new standards will apply to newly submitted vehicle models starting January 1, 2027, while previously approved models must submit technical parameters and verification data by July 1, 2027. Testing requirements include at least one year of environmental validation and 30,000 kilometers of reliability testing.

title_zh: 字节据报加速个人 AI 智能体，拟将 Spell 与豆包结合
content_zh:
据财新报道，字节跳动正在加快个人 AI 智能体的研发，计划把代号为 Spell 的项目与豆包产品结合，尽快对外推出。财新 10 月 9 日从字节内部人士处获悉，这项研发在国庆假期前已加紧推进。

Spell 项目于今年 4 月启动，延续了 2025 年豆包手机助手在个人智能体方向上的探索。彼时，豆包内部已启动相关产品内测。

报道介绍，新产品由豆包手机助手团队主导，Spell 项目与豆包对话团队共同负责。Meta Muse 等个人智能体在海外走红后，字节进一步加快了项目进度。
title_en: ByteDance Accelerates Personal AI Agent Development by Integrating "Spell" with Doubao
content_en:
ByteDance is accelerating the development of personal AI agents and plans to integrate its project code-named "Spell" with its Doubao platform for an expedited public release, according to a report by *Caixin*. The initiative saw intensified internal momentum leading up to the Golden Week holiday.

Launched in April, the Spell project builds upon ByteDance's earlier explorations into personal AI agents via the Doubao mobile assistant team. The combined effort is now being jointly managed by the mobile assistant team, the Spell team, and the core Doubao conversational AI team.

The accelerated push comes as ByteDance aims to strengthen its competitive position in the rapidly evolving consumer AI space, driven in part by the rising global popularity of personal AI agents like Meta Muse.

title_zh: Meta 据报暂缓向 Anthropic 提供 AI 算力
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 今年早些时候曾致电 Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang，寻求更多算力。Meta 内部讨论后，最终决定暂时不向 Anthropic 提供芯片算力。

Claude Code 的意外走红让 Anthropic 遭遇算力紧张，并导致服务频繁中断。为寻找资源，联合创始人 Tom Brown 在 3 月底到 xAI 办公室与马斯克商谈；Anthropic 随后于 5 月宣布与 SpaceX 达成协议，租用超过 300 兆瓦算力。

报道指出，大量数据中心仍处于建设阶段，眼下可实际使用的容量远少于宣布中的规模。成熟供应商开始要求多年合同和更高预付款，一些初创公司则转向安全或基础设施较弱的服务商。还有公司为防备未来短缺而超额预订，也有公司因产品需求不及预期，被迫转售剩余容量。
title_en: Meta Reportedly Declines Anthropic's Request for AI Compute Capacity
content_en:
Meta has decided against leasing AI compute capacity to Anthropic following internal discussions, according to a report from the *Wall Street Journal*. Earlier this year, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reached out directly to Meta's Chief AI Officer, Alexandr Wang, seeking extra computing power to alleviate severe infrastructure bottlenecks.

The capacity crunch—driven by the unexpected surge in popularity of Anthropic's Claude Code—resulted in frequent service outages for the startup. To secure needed resources, Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown met with Elon Musk at xAI in late March, leading to a agreement in May to rent over 300 megawatts of compute capacity from SpaceX.

The situation underscores broader friction in the AI sector, where actual operational data center capacity lags far behind announced numbers. Established cloud vendors are increasingly demanding multi-year commitments and larger upfront payments, forcing AI startups to overbook capacity or turn to alternative providers with less robust infrastructure.

title_zh: Netflix 称约 300 部作品已使用 AI，导演谈降本与创作取舍
content_zh:
Netflix 亚太制作高级总监 Lee Sung-gyun 在釜山国际电影节论坛上表示，公司约有 300 部作品已以不同方式使用 AI，应用环节包括预演、美术设计、布景构思、剪辑和视觉特效。

据 Variety 现场报道，Netflix 展示了旗下 Eyeline 工作室结合实拍、传统特效和生成工具的混合制作流程。印度作品《Glory》也借助 AI 与视觉特效完成大规模人群场面；Lee 称，在原有预算和工期下，这些镜头本来可能被舍弃。

同场的《犯罪都市》导演姜允成介绍，他为海上军事题材项目《The Gulf of Aden》用可灵制作过全 AI 测试片。团队为融资测算时，预计采用这套流程可将制作预算降低约 40%，节省来自特效、拍摄简化与周期缩短。这是具体项目的测算，并非已完成影片的普遍降本比例。

姜允成同时指出，AI 让一些曾因预算取消的项目重新具备可行性，但也可能省去多人讨论、尝试和积累经验的过程。他认为，画面质量虽提升，传达情感、打动观众仍需人的创作；Lee 也强调，生成结果最终需要人再处理一次。
title_en: Netflix Integrates AI into 300 Productions, Weighing Cost Savings Against Creativity
content_en:
Netflix has integrated artificial intelligence into approximately 300 titles across pre-visualization, set design, editing, and visual effects, according to Lee Sung-gyun, Senior Director of APAC Production, speaking at the Busan International Film Festival. Notable applications include using AI for large crowd scenes in the Indian film *Glory*, shots that might otherwise have been cut due to budget and schedule constraints.

Director Kang Yoon-sung revealed that using AI tools like Kling for a test reel on his upcoming project, *The Gulf of Aden*, projected a potential 40% reduction in production costs by simplifying VFX and shortening schedules. While AI enables budget-tight projects to become viable, both Kang and Lee stressed that human creativity remains essential for emotional resonance and final processing.

title_zh: 长鑫披露 4F² 内存架构进展，首款服务器产品预计年底推出
content_zh:
长鑫存储总裁曹堪宇在 10 月 10 日的第四届集成芯片和芯粒大会上披露，长鑫预计年底推出采用 4F² 架构的新一代 DDR5 RDIMM 服务器内存产品。据第一财经、21 世纪经济报道，这项技术在存储单元和制造工艺两方面作出调整。

目前 DRAM 主流存储单元采用 6F² 架构，F 代表最小特征尺寸。4F² 将单元面积缩小至四倍最小特征尺寸的平方，提高单位面积的存储密度。长鑫采用自研 VSG 垂直包围沟道晶体管，让晶体管竖立布置，以增强栅极控制能力，改善漏电与短沟道效应。

另一项调整是将 DRAM 存储阵列与 CMOS 外围逻辑电路的制造工艺分开，再通过晶圆级混合键合实现互联，使逻辑性能和存储密度可以分别优化。曹堪宇称，长鑫相关公开专利族已超过 300 件。

首代产品选择服务器用 DDR5 RDIMM，这类内存需要满足持续运行、稳定性和兼容性要求。此次披露的是研发进展与年底产品计划。
title_en: CXMT Discloses 4F² DRAM Architecture, Plans First Server Memory Release by Year-End
content_en:
ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) disclosed advancements in its next-generation 4F² DRAM architecture at the 4th Integrated Chips and Chiplets Conference, announcing plans to launch its first DDR5 RDIMM server memory product by the end of the year.

Moving away from the industry-standard 6F² DRAM, the 4F² architecture significantly reduces memory cell size to boost storage density per unit area. CXMT utilizes proprietary Vertical Surround Gate (VSG) transistors arranged vertically to enhance gate control while mitigating leakage and short-channel effects.

Furthermore, CXMT separates the manufacturing of the DRAM memory array from the CMOS peripheral logic circuits, joining them through wafer-level hybrid bonding to optimize logic performance and memory density independently. The company reported owning over 300 public patent families related to this technology.

title_zh: 英伟达据报洽谈收购 Reflection AI，也可能追加投资
content_zh:
据《金融时报》援引直接知情人士报道，英伟达正就收购美国开放权重模型公司 Reflection AI，或进一步加深投资关系展开谈判。磋商仍在早期，交易可能在未来数周达成，也可能告吹，双方均拒绝置评。

潜在方案包括完整收购、追加股权投资，以及「收购式招聘」：英伟达聘用其员工并获得技术许可。另一种可能是提供更多芯片和算力。《金融时报》称，英伟达已向 Reflection 投入 8 亿美元，是其最大股东之一；这家公司今年 3 月融资时的估值为 250 亿美元。

Reflection 由曾参与 Google Gemini 研发的 Misha Laskin 和 Ioannis Antonoglou 创立，本周刚推出首款可定制的公开 AI 产品，运行在英伟达芯片上。开放权重模型允许用户在自己的硬件上运行并进行定制，Reflection 也是美国发展本土开放模型生态的参与者。

英伟达已有 Nemotron 开放权重模型系列。《金融时报》指出，公司目前仍缺少自己的前沿规模模型。
title_en: Nvidia in Talks to Acquire or Expand Stake in Reflection AI, Report Says
content_en:
Nvidia is in early-stage talks to acquire or increase its stake in US-based open-weight AI startup Reflection AI, according to the Financial Times. Options under negotiation include a complete takeover, an additional equity investment, or an acqui-hire model to secure talent and technology licenses.

Nvidia is already a major shareholder in Reflection AI, having previously invested $800 million. The startup was valued at $25 billion during its funding round in March. Reflection AI was co-founded by former Google Gemini researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou and recently launched its first open, customizable AI product powered by Nvidia hardware.

While Nvidia currently develops its own Nemotron open-weight model series, acquiring Reflection AI would help bolster its capabilities in frontier-scale AI models.

title_zh: 💡 东芝人力负责人：AI 改变初级岗位，面试更看重解决问题的过程
content_zh:
AI 开始筛选简历之后，初级招聘人员如何积累经验？东芝美洲区首席人力资源官 Jason Richard Desentz 在 Business Insider 刊发的口述文章中表示，初级岗位仍会保留，但工作内容和招聘标准正在变化。

他举例说，面对上千份简历，招聘人员往往看完前几十份、找到一些合适人选就会停下，余下的好候选人可能被漏掉。东芝为招聘建立 AI Bot，希望让人员把时间转向与经理确认需求、设计更好的问题和改善新人入职体验；AI 生成的面试指南也应帮助找到需要追问的地方，而非直接排除可能学会工作的人。

面试时，Desentz 更关注候选人如何拆解问题、用数据支持判断、推动没有积极参与的同组成员，以及面对突然变化的预算或任务期限如何调整方案。没有工作经验的人，也可以用大学里的真实经历说明思考过程。

对于员工担忧，他主张承认工作正在变化，带着团队一起应对。东芝从员工最不喜欢的重复事务入手试做 Bot，并安排 AI 基础课程和内部展示。他强调要给员工留出试验时间，允许他们在学习中犯错。
title_en: Toshiba HR Chief: AI Is Reshaping Entry-Level Roles to Focus on Problem-Solving
content_en:
Artificial intelligence is changing the nature of entry-level positions rather than eliminating them, according to Jason Richard Desentz, Chief Human Resources Officer at Toshiba America. As AI transforms recruitment, hiring standards are evolving to prioritize practical problem-solving capabilities over traditional resume metrics.

By automating initial resume screening, Toshiba's custom AI bots prevent qualified candidates from being overlooked in high-volume applicant pools. This shift frees HR professionals to focus on higher-value tasks, such as collaborating with hiring managers, crafting targeted interview strategies, and enhancing the onboarding experience.

During interviews, Desentz emphasizes evaluating how candidates break down complex challenges, leverage data to support decisions, navigate team dynamics, and adapt to sudden budget or deadline changes. Applicants without formal work experience are encouraged to demonstrate these cognitive skills through academic and real-world projects.

To address workplace anxiety around automation, Toshiba advocates for transparency and hands-on learning. The company began its AI rollout by automating repetitive tasks, alongside offering foundational AI courses and internal showcases to give employees time to experiment and learn from mistakes.

title_zh: 腾讯云开源 TeamAI，团队 Skill 可跨 Agent 共享
content_zh:
腾讯云近日对外介绍并开源内部使用的 TeamAI 工具，希望把分散在不同 AI 编程工具里的团队配置、Skill 和经验，通过 Git 仓库统一管理。项目采用 MIT 许可证，已提供 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、CodeBuddy 等工具的适配。

TeamAI 将能力分为三层：

后两层仍标记为 Beta。成员可以继续使用各自熟悉的编程工具，团队共享内容则在同一仓库内维护和更新。
title_en: Tencent Cloud Open-Sources TeamAI to Enable Cross-Agent Skill Sharing
content_en:
Tencent Cloud has open-sourced TeamAI, an internal collaboration tool designed to streamline AI engineering workflows. Released under the MIT license, TeamAI allows development teams to centralize configurations, custom AI skills, and shared knowledge across multiple AI coding assistants using a single Git repository.

Out of the box, TeamAI supports leading AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and CodeBuddy. The system organizes AI capabilities into a multi-tiered architecture, providing a unified structure while advanced layers remain in active beta development.

By leveraging a shared repository, team members can continue using their preferred AI coding environments without sacrificing team alignment. Configurations and collective skills are automatically synchronized, making collaborative AI-assisted development more efficient and manageable.

title_zh: 银河战舰 700 上市，先享价 17.98 万元起
content_zh:
10 月 10 日，吉利银河战舰 700 在杭州上市，共推出三种动力、六款车型。入门两驱探索版先享指导价为 17.98 万元，叠加置换补贴后的限时焕新价为 16.98 万元。

新车基于 GTA 原生新能源越野架构，将一体式大梁嵌入车身，全系采用五座布局。动力与底盘按版本分层：

全系配备 47.14kWh 宁德时代磷酸铁锂电池，支持峰值 6C 快充。座舱采用 Flyme Auto 2，保留实体挡杆与越野功能按键，前后排座椅通风、加热为标配；官方还提供车顶帐篷拓展方案。

本次限时上市权益要求用户在 10 月 31 日前完成大定锁单、尾款支付和提车，置换补贴另有适用条件。
title_en: Geely Launches Galaxy Battleship 700 Off-Roader Starting at 179,800 Yuan
content_en:
Geely officially launched the Galaxy Battleship 700 off-road SUV in Hangzhou, offering six variants across three powertrain configurations. The entry-level model debuts with an early-bird price of 179,800 yuan, which drops to 169,800 yuan after trade-in subsidies for customers who complete their orders by October 31.

Built on Geely's GTA native new-energy off-road architecture, the five-seat SUV features an integrated ladder-frame body for enhanced durability. Powering the entire lineup is a 47.14 kWh CATL lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery pack capable of ultra-fast 6C charging.

Inside, the cabin is powered by the Flyme Auto 2 infotainment system, retaining essential physical gear levers and off-road control buttons for practical operation. Both front and rear seats feature standard heating and ventilation, while optional factory accessories include an expandable roof tent setup.

title_zh: 阿里升级 NBA Chat，赛事回放可在 10 至 15 秒内生成
content_zh:
NBA 中国赛 2026 于 10 月 9 日在中国澳门开赛。阿里巴巴介绍，基于千问打造的智能篮球助手 NBA Chat 已升级为多模态交互，支持语音提问、文字及视频回复，并接入 NBA 知识图谱和视频媒资库。

NBA Chat 同时上线三个角色化 Agent，分别采用马布里、解说员王猛和篮球主播美娜的风格，提供互动、解说及赛后资讯。去年首次用于 NBA 赛场的 360 度实时回放技术，今年加入「主角时刻」：由 Wan3.0 视频与图像生成模型支持，聚焦攻防球员，在 10 至 15 秒内生成环绕回放。

场内观众可用自己的照片生成独行侠或火箭队主题 AI 视频，线上球迷也能在千问 App 使用同款能力。淘宝 88VIP 连续第二年成为中国赛首席合作伙伴，提供门票抽奖、优先通道、前排席位、定制联名周边及球星互动等权益。高德则在 NBA House 提供室内导航、机器狗导览，并开设扫街榜线下市集。
title_en: Alibaba Upgrades NBA Chat with AI Replay Generation in Under 15 Seconds
content_en:
Alibaba has unveiled significant upgrades to NBA Chat, its Qwen-powered intelligent assistant, ahead of the NBA China Games 2026 in Macao. The assistant now features multimodal capabilities, accepting voice inputs while delivering responses in text and video, backed by the official NBA knowledge graph and video asset library.

The update introduces three persona-driven AI agents modeled after basketball star Stephon Marbury and popular sports commentators, providing interactive commentary and post-game insights. Additionally, a new feature powered by Alibaba's Wan 3.0 generative model produces 360-degree "Protagonist Moment" replays focused on key players within 10 to 15 seconds.

Fans can also generate personalized team-themed AI videos both at the venue and via the Qwen app. Alibaba ecosystem services, including Taobao 88VIP and Amap, are supporting the event with exclusive fan perks, indoor robot dog navigation, and offline promotional activities.

title_zh: 小米澎湃 OS 4 正式版 10 月 15 日起分批推送
content_zh:
小米澎湃 OS 公告君 10 月 10 日公布升级安排：澎湃 OS 4 正式版将于 10 月 15 日起陆续分批推送，首批覆盖 Xiaomi 17 系列、REDMI K100 Pro 系列等机型，之后逐步扩展至更多存量设备。

据公告，Beta 版内测招募将于 10 月 14 日中午 12 点结束。仍希望参与的用户可在小米社区内测中心报名，通过后在「设置—我的设备—系统版本」中升级。

本轮正式版包含超级小爱 2.0 与 MiMo 大模型相关能力，带来专家模式、灵感球交互，并升级跨设备协同与系统流畅度。
title_en: Xiaomi to Roll Out HyperOS 4 Official Version Starting October 15
content_en:
Xiaomi has announced that the official release of HyperOS 4 will begin rolling out in batches starting October 15. The initial wave will target flagship devices, including the Xiaomi 17 series and the REDMI K100 Pro series, before gradually expanding to additional legacy models.

For users interested in testing the software early, the Beta recruitment phase will conclude on October 14 at noon. Eligible users can sign up through the Xiaomi Community's internal testing center and update via system settings once approved.

The major software update integrates Super XiaoAI 2.0 and Xiaomi's MiMo large language model. Key enhancements include an expert mode, interactive "inspiration ball" features, improved cross-device connectivity, and boosted overall system performance.

title_zh: 阿里 Qoder 上线 Fast 模式，首次响应缩短至 3 秒
content_zh:
阿里 Qoder 10 月 10 日上线 Fast 模式，率先用于桌面端，需更新至 0.4.4 及以上版本。个人版和企业版均可使用，中国版与国际版同步支持。

中国版新增 Fast 档位，国际版原有的 Performance 模式则直接升级为 Fast，原用户无需额外操作。官方给出的数据是，首次响应时间由 8 秒缩短至 3 秒，Credits 消耗系数由 1.1x 降至 0.8x，约减少 27%；其表示输出质量保持不变。

Qoder 产品家族的其他产品也计划陆续加入 Fast 模式，目前这项更新首先面向桌面端开放。
title_en: Alibaba Launches Fast Mode for Qoder, Slashing Initial AI Response Times to 3 Seconds
content_en:
Alibaba has introduced a new "Fast Mode" for its AI development platform, Qoder, initially available on desktop version 0.4.4 and above. The feature is available across both personal and enterprise editions globally, with international users automatically upgraded from the previous Performance mode.

According to official data, Fast Mode dramatically improves efficiency by cutting initial response times from 8 seconds down to 3 seconds. Furthermore, credit consumption has been reduced by approximately 27% (from a 1.1x multiplier to 0.8x), all while maintaining the platform's original output quality.

Currently exclusive to the desktop interface, Alibaba plans to roll out Fast Mode across other products in the Qoder ecosystem in upcoming updates.

title_zh: 罗技预览矩阵式会议音箱，可将两种语言投向不同座区
content_zh:
罗技 10 月 8 日预览 Rally Speaker 2 Pro 和 Rally Speaker 2 Max 两款音频系统，以自研 Sound Shape 技术进入专业视听市场。两款音箱安装在房间前方，分别使用 32 个和 64 个微型驱动单元，面向大型会议室和培训空间。

这套系统通过控制声波的叠加与抵消，把声音投向指定听音区域，同时减少声音向墙壁等方向扩散。罗技称，这可以降低反射和回声，并让前后排保持更均匀的音量，减少传统天花板音箱的布线和安装需求。

罗技还演示了一个仍在开发的多语言方案：单台 Max 可同时把两路不同音频投向房间两侧，例如左侧听英语、右侧听法语。公司正与合作伙伴研究接入 Microsoft Teams 的 Interpreter 和 Zoom Meetings 的 Voice Translator。

两款产品现可在罗技硅谷体验中心演示，计划于 2027 年夏季商业上市。
title_en: Logitech Unveils Beamforming Conference Speakers Capable of Dual-Language Audio Direction
content_en:
Logitech has previewed the Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Rally Speaker 2 Max, marking its entry into the professional AV market with proprietary Sound Shape technology. Designed for large meeting rooms and training spaces, the front-of-room speaker systems utilize arrays of 32 and 64 micro-drivers, respectively.

By controlling soundwave interference, the technology directs audio to specific seating zones while minimizing dispersion toward walls. This targeted approach reduces reflections and echoes while delivering consistent volume levels across front and back rows, eliminating the need for complex ceiling speaker installations.

Additionally, Logitech showcased a multi-language feature currently in development. A single Rally Speaker 2 Max unit can simultaneously beam separate audio tracks to different areas—such as English to the left side of the room and French to the right. The company is collaborating with partners to integrate this system with Microsoft Teams' Interpreter and Zoom's Voice Translator tools.

Both products are currently being demonstrated at Logitech’s Silicon Valley Experience Center, with a commercial rollout scheduled for summer 2027.

title_zh: RSIGym 开源，让 AI 自主设计实验、训练并改进模型
content_zh:
Evolvent AI 团队开源了 RSIGym，把训练、推理、评测和沙箱执行做成 AI 可以调用的服务。研究 Agent 自行设计实验、生成训练数据、训练候选模型，再根据结果调整方案；平台统一管理权限和预算，并公开实验轨迹。

环境提供三种路线：只改训练数据、固定模型权重而改执行框架，以及同时优化数据、训练设置和框架。主实验让 6 个研究 Agent 在 5 个领域中改进同一个起点：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 加最小执行框架，每次基准实验的平台服务预算为 500 美元，研究 Agent 推理和最终正式评测费用另计。

团队报告，30 次联合优化实验中有 29 次优于初始系统。Opus 5 的 RSI-Index 最高，为 0.4809，表示平均弥补了距满分剩余差距的 48.09%，并非最终准确率。每种研究配置只运行一次，最终评测复用了开发阶段可见的任务。

另一项让 Qwen3.8-27B 研究自身的实验，则从初始 56.66% 降至 56.26%：小规模开发集上的进步没有转化为整体提升。该结果展示了自动研究的可执行过程，也保留了自我改进未必奏效的边界。
title_en: Evolvent AI Open-Sources RSIGym to Enable Autonomous AI-Driven Model Optimization
content_en:
Evolvent AI has open-sourced RSIGym, a new platform designed to turn model training, inference, evaluation, and sandboxed execution into callable services for AI research agents. The environment enables autonomous agents to design experiments, generate training data, train candidate models, and refine their strategies based on outcomes while maintaining centralized budget management and transparent activity logging.

RSIGym supports three distinct research pathways: modifying training data alone, tuning execution frameworks with fixed weights, or jointly optimizing data, training configurations, and frameworks. In a core benchmark testing six research agents across five domains starting from a Qwen3.5-35B baseline, 29 out of 30 joint optimization experiments surpassed the initial benchmark system. Claude 3.5 Opus achieved the top RSI-Index of 0.4809, closing 48.09% of the performance gap toward a perfect score.

However, the framework also highlights current boundaries in self-improving AI. In a separate test where Qwen3.8-27B was assigned to improve itself, its performance slightly dropped from 56.66% to 56.26%, demonstrating that gains achieved on small development sets do not always translate to broader task performance.

title_zh: 2027 款启源 A06 上市，限时权益价 11.69 万元起
content_zh:
2027 款长安启源 A06 于 10 月 10 日上市，共提供 5 款配置，官方指导价从 11.99 万元至 15.99 万元，限时权益价为 11.69 万元至 15.69 万元。此次改款新增「激昂红」车色，并增加 800km 长续航版本。

新车全系标配宁德时代电池，采用 800V 碳化硅高压平台，支持 6C 闪充，CLTC 纯电续航分为 630km 和 800km 两档。CNMO 引述的补能数据为，电量从 30% 充至 80% 需要 9 分钟。

车身长宽高为 4885×1916×1496mm，轴距 2922mm，底盘采用全铝前双叉臂加后五连杆悬架。配置序列包括 630 舒享版、630 尊享版、630 激光耀享版，以及 800 激光远航版、800 激光旗舰版。
title_en: 2027 Changan Qiyuan A06 Launched with 800V Fast Charging and 800km Range
content_en:
Changan Automobile has officially launched the 2027 Qiyuan A06 EV, offering five distinct trims with official pricing ranging from 119,900 to 159,900 yuan, alongside promotional launch pricing starting at 116,900 yuan. The updated model introduces a new "Fiery Red" color option and adds an extended-range 800 km variant.

Built on an 800V Silicon Carbide (SiC) high-voltage platform with CATL battery packs standard across all models, the Qiyuan A06 supports 6C ultra-fast charging, enabling a 30% to 80% charge in just 9 minutes. Buyers can choose between CLTC pure electric range options of 630 km or 800 km.

Measuring 4,885 mm in length with a 2,922 mm wheelbase, the sedan features an all-aluminum front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension setup. The model lineup includes three 630 km variants and two premium 800 km variants equipped with LiDAR technology.

title_zh: lululemon 开启「一起好状态」活动，会发声的乒乓台来到上海
content_zh:
lululemon 连续第六年发起「一起好状态」年度活动。10 月 7 日，首场感受日在上海上音歌剧院举行，李宇春、邓亚萍、残奥铁三运动员王家超、人文学者梁永安及正念导师 Jesse Israel，通过演讲、对话和呼吸习练，讨论身体、心理与社交三个维度的好状态。

艺术家 James de Wulf 创作的「幸福的回响」乒乓台也首次来到中国。这件曾在 2025 年巴黎 Design Miami 展出的装置，以经过特殊调音的哑光铝板制作，乒乓球落在不同位置时会触发不同音调。邓亚萍与艺术家在现场挥拍演示了这套声音互动。

10 月 8 日至 18 日，乒乓台将在上海西岸中环限时展出，公众可参与体验。10 月 10 日至 17 日，lululemon 还将联合上海多家场馆推出八天主题热汗课程，全国门店同步举办系列课程。活动将上音歌剧院的对话与运动体验延伸至社区。
title_en: Lululemon Launches Annual Well-Being Campaign in Shanghai Featuring Interactive Sound Ping-Pong
content_en:
Athleisure brand lululemon has launched its sixth annual "Find Your Well-Being" campaign in Shanghai. The opening event at the Shanghai Symphony Hall featured high-profile speakers—including pop star Chris Lee, Olympic ping-pong champion Deng Yaping, Paralympic triathlete Wang Jiachao, scholar Liang Yongan, and mindfulness coach Jesse Israel—discussing physical, mental, and social wellness through talks and breathwork exercises.

A key highlight of the campaign is the Chinese debut of "Echoes of Happiness," an interactive acoustic ping-pong table created by artist James de Wulf. First showcased at Design Miami/Paris 2025, the matte-aluminum installation features specially tuned surfaces that produce distinct musical tones when struck by a ping-pong ball.

The installation is open for public experience at West Bund Central in Shanghai through October 18. Additionally, lululemon is partnering with local athletic venues to host an eight-day series of workout sessions, alongside store events nationwide to engage local communities.

title_zh: 七部门发文纠治电商「自动跟价」「全网最低价」竞争
content_zh:
商务部等七部门发布实施品质电商「五优」行动的通知，提出协同整治无序非理性竞争，纠治电商平台「自动跟价」「全网最低价」等行为，并规范平台佣金抽成、商家评级规则，避免挤压品质商家的生存空间。

通知要求，电商平台制定、修改规则时，落实规则公示和公开征求意见；优化商品展示、推荐和营销活动机制，将商品质量、服务口碑和信用信息作为品质导向。有关部门还将建立平台与中小商家的对话沟通机制，打击刷单炒信。

在全链路品控方面，通知引导平台建立首席质量官制度，完善线上服务质量评价体系，并支持政务数据核验，协助平台比对商家证照。围绕「618」「双 11」等消费节点，各方将加强对平台的指导与规范。
title_en: China Targets E-Commerce Price Wars and Aggressive Price-Matching Tactics
content_en:
Seven Chinese government agencies, led by the Ministry of Commerce, have launched a joint initiative to curb irrational competition across the e-commerce sector. The directive specifically targets aggressive practices such as automated price-matching algorithms and mandatory "lowest price nationwide" guarantees, which disproportionately squeeze quality merchants.

The guidelines require e-commerce platforms to improve transparency when altering platform rules and to adjust their product recommendation algorithms. Instead of relying solely on low pricing, platforms must now factor in product quality, customer service reputation, and merchant credit ratings.

Regulators will also establish better communication channels between platforms and small-to-medium businesses, crack down on fake reviews, and promote online quality-assurance systems. Strict guidance and oversight will be enforced during major shopping festivals like 618 and Singles' Day (Double 11).

title_zh: 胖东来梦之城公示酒店规划，高度不超过 99.95 米
content_zh:
胖东来梦之城的酒店、文化中心和幸福讲堂规划进入批前公示。许昌市自然资源和规划局 10 月 9 日公布的二至四期建设工程规划许可信息显示，四期酒店规划面积约 6.6 万平方米，建筑高度不超过 99.95 米。

另外两个配套项目中，二期幸福讲堂面积 5630 平方米、高度不超过 24 米；三期文化中心面积约 3.62 万平方米、高度不超过 25.45 米。

据极目新闻此前披露的规划信息，梦之城一期主要建设商业综合体，建筑面积约 46.7 万平方米，主体共 8 层。项目位于许昌市东城区、莲城大道以北和许州路以东，临近高铁许昌东站。

于东来曾在 7 月表示，梦之城将在 3 年内开业。此次公示展示的是酒店等后续配套的规划内容。
title_en: Pang Dong Lai Unveils Hotel and Cultural Center Plans for 'Dream City' Project
content_en:
Urban planning authorities in Xuchang, Henan province, have published pre-approval plans for the hotel, cultural center, and lecture hall facilities at Pang Dong Lai's upcoming "Dream City" development.

According to official filings, Phase 4 of the project features a hotel spanning approximately 66,000 square meters with a maximum height of 99.95 meters. Associated facilities include Phase 2's 5,630-square-meter "Happiness Hall" lecture center and Phase 3's 36,200-square-meter cultural center, capped at heights of 24 meters and 25.45 meters, respectively.

Located near Xuchang East High-Speed Railway Station, the centerpiece of the overall project (Phase 1) is a massive 467,000-square-meter, eight-story commercial complex. Pang Dong Lai founder Yu Donglai previously stated that the entire mega-complex is slated to open within three years.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜经典 Fiat 500 变身电动海滨小车
content_zh:
意大利汽车定制工作室 Garage Italia 把经典 Fiat 500 Spiaggina 改造成了一辆电动敞篷小车。它沿用无车门、开放式车身与可拆卸顶篷的海滨车设定，面向停靠地中海港口后、需要在沿岸小镇短途出行的游艇用户。

据 Design Milk 介绍，这辆车在后部装入电动机，搭配 11kWh 电池，WLTP 续航约 140 公里。车主可以选择 18 种车身颜色，也可以定制色彩；顶篷、坐垫采用意大利纺织品牌 Mariaflora 的面料，Bonacina 手工编织的座椅则提供藤编或耐日晒、盐雾的复合材料版本，地板使用防水 EVA 材料。

这套改造保留了 Fiat 500 Jolly 当年为海边休闲出行而做的形态，动力改成电驱后，游艇上也无需再为它携带汽油。车辆起价为 8.5 万欧元，选装和税费另计。
title_en: Garage Italia Electrifies the Classic Fiat 500 into a Chic Beach Buggy
content_en:
Italian custom studio Garage Italia has transformed the iconic Fiat 500 Spiaggina into a sleek, open-top electric vehicle. Retaining its signature doorless frame and removable canopy, the seaside cruiser is tailored for yacht owners looking for stylish short-distance transport along Mediterranean coastal towns.

The modern makeover features a rear-mounted electric motor paired with an 11 kWh battery, delivering a WLTP range of approximately 140 kilometers. Owners can choose from 18 body colors or opt for bespoke paint jobs. The cabin features Mariaflora fabric for the soft-top and cushions, waterproof EVA flooring, and hand-woven Bonacina seats made from natural rattan or weather-resistant composites.

By transitioning to an electric powertrain, yacht owners no longer need to carry gasoline onboard to power their tender vehicle. Starting at €85,000 (excluding options and taxes), the build offers a modern, eco-friendly take on the classic Fiat 500 Jolly.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《Animals》让一场绑架案撕开竞选家庭的秘密
content_zh:
洛杉矶市长候选人 Mark Kimball 正在为选举奔忙，一通电话却告知他的儿子遭到绑架。在 Netflix 已上线的惊悚片《Animals》中，他与妻子 Abigail 必须筹措赎金，而夫妻关系、竞选利益与家庭秘密也在这一夜接连暴露。

影片由本·阿弗莱克执导并出演 Mark，凯丽·华盛顿饰演 Abigail，史蒂文·元饰演竞选经理，吉莲·安德森出演协助处理危机的神秘掮客。故事在洛杉矶展开，竞选团队试图维持的公众形象，与一家人在绑架案中的选择不断发生冲突。

Variety 影评人 Guy Lodge 肯定影片紧凑的推进和阿弗莱克逐渐失控的表演，也指出政治讽刺、婚姻冲突与通俗惊悚元素之间的切换，削弱了部分情节的真实感。他认为影片靠接连转折保持吸引力，但没有把对权力和不平等的追问展开到底。
title_en: Netflix Thriller 'Animals' Exposes Political and Personal Secrets Behind a Shock Kidnapping
content_en:
In Netflix's suspense thriller *Animals*, Los Angeles mayoral candidate Mark Kimball sees his political ambitions upended when his son is suddenly kidnapped. Forced to scramble for ransom alongside his wife Abigail, the high-stakes ordeal turns into a pressure cooker that exposes deep marital cracks and campaign secrets over a single night.

Directed by and starring Ben Affleck as Mark, the film features Kerry Washington as Abigail, Steven Yeun as the campaign manager, and Gillian Anderson as a mysterious crisis fixer. Set against a bustling L.A. backdrop, the plot spotlights the constant friction between maintaining a polished public image and making desperate private choices.

Critics have praised the film's relentless pacing and Affleck's compelling performance as a man unraveling under pressure. However, reviews also note that while its non-stop twists keep audiences hooked, the rapid shifts between political satire, domestic drama, and pulp thriller tropes diminish the story's realism.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《创意行为：存在即答案》从注意力谈起
content_zh:
音乐制作人里克·鲁宾在《创意行为：存在即答案》中，把创作放回日常的观察、感知和选择。他以自己与不同类型音乐人合作的经验为起点，讨论怎样留意线索、保存灵感、进行试验，以及把尚未成形的想法逐步推进到完成。

全书由 78 篇思考组成，话题涉及初学者心态、自我怀疑、习惯、合作与规则。开篇「人人都是创作者」把重新布置房间、解决问题、开展对话也纳入创造的范围；鲁宾将艺术家的生活方式描述为一种注意力实践，强调感知、过滤信息与形成经验之间的联系。

英文原作 The Creative Act: A Way of Being 于 2023 年出版。中文版由重轻翻译，中信出版集团于 2025 年 4 月推出，共 416 页。鲁宾曾与阿黛尔、Jay-Z、Johnny Cash 等音乐人合作，他将音乐制作经验转化为围绕创作过程的思考。
title_en: Rick Rubin Explores Creativity as an Art of Attention in 'The Creative Act'
content_en:
In *The Creative Act: A Way of Being*, legendary music producer Rick Rubin distills decades of experience working with icons like Adele, Jay-Z, and Johnny Cash into a practical philosophy on artistic living. Rubin frames creation not as an exclusive talent, but as an everyday practice rooted in observation, awareness, and personal choices.

Structured into 78 reflective essays, the book tackles topics ranging from maintaining a beginner's mindset and overcoming self-doubt to building habits and breaking rules. Opening with the premise that "everyone is a creator," Rubin argues that everyday actions—such as rearranging a room or engaging in conversation—are creative acts driven by how we pay attention to and process the world.

Originally published in English in 2023, the 416-page Chinese edition translated by Zhongqing is scheduled for release by CITIC Publishing Group in April 2025.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《沉星之序》
content_zh:
《时空幻境》《见证者》的制作人 Jonathan Blow 与 Thekla 团队带来新作《沉星之序》。这款叙事解谜冒险游戏包含超过 1000 个手工设计的谜题，玩家将在四个规则各异的平行世界里探索，逐步解锁新的角色与机制。

女王、盗贼、战士、巫师，甚至一艘会说话的小船，都可以成为可操控角色。每个世界有独立的故事、规则和危险；随着角色相遇、世界交汇，原本分开的能力与解谜机制也会相互组合。玩家可以按自己的节奏探索，随时返回不同世界，并通过散落的笔记拼出故事。

游戏由 Arc Games 与 Gamirror Games 发行，已于 10 月 8 日登陆 Steam，支持 Windows PC，提供简体中文界面和字幕。中文配音计划在发售后约一个月更新。截至 10 月 11 日，Steam 总体评价为「好评如潮」。
title_en: Game Pick: Unravel Parallel Worlds in Jonathan Blow's 'Order of the Sinking Star'
content_en:
Jonathan Blow, the creator behind *Braid* and *The Witness*, has teamed up with the studio Thekla to release his latest title, *Order of the Sinking Star*. This narrative puzzle adventure features over 1,000 handcrafted puzzles across four parallel worlds, each governed by distinct rules and mechanics.

Players can control a unique roster of characters, including a queen, a thief, a warrior, a wizard, and even a talking boat. As characters meet and their worlds intertwine, their abilities and puzzle mechanics combine in unexpected ways. The game offers non-linear exploration, allowing players to move freely between worlds at their own pace and piece together the lore through scattered notes.

Published by Arc Games and Gamirror Games, *Order of the Sinking Star* launched on Steam for Windows PC on October 8. It currently features Simplified Chinese UI and subtitles, with Chinese voiceovers arriving about a month post-launch. The title has already earned an "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating on Steam as of October 11.
